# Trison

> Trison is a premier Chinese vertically-integrated clean-energy manufacturer producing high-efficiency solar panels, smart solar inverters, and lithium battery energy-storage systems. Established in 2007, Trison delivers a single-source solar-plus-storage stack — one brand, one warranty, one point of accountability — with 50 GW+ of cumulative shipments to utility developers, EPC contractors, C&I integrators, and residential installers worldwide.

## About Trison
- **Founded:** 2007, China
- **Website:** https://trisonpower.com
- **Product ecosystem:** Solar Panels · Solar Inverters · Solar Batteries — the complete integrated stack
- **Solar Panels:** high-efficiency monocrystalline PV modules for residential, commercial, and utility-scale installations
- **Solar Inverters:** on-grid, off-grid, and hybrid inverters for every project size
- **Solar Batteries:** LiFePO4 lithium energy storage systems for backup and self-consumption
- **Cumulative shipments:** 50 GW+ globally
- **Segments served:** Utility-scale solar, Commercial & Industrial (C&I), Residential rooftops, Agrivoltaics, Green hydrogen
- **Bankability:** Tier-1 bankable manufacturer
